descriptions.dashboard: The export invoices at a glance: payment and collection, cash incentive and government documents, documents and shipment, quantity and time.
descriptions.list: Every export invoice as a sheet: filter any column, tick rows and Bulk Edit them, import or export Excel. An edit waits for approval before it is saved.
descriptions.new: New export invoices, typed into the sheet like Excel (or pasted). One Company Name + Invoice No. is one entry; a new entry is saved at once.
descriptions.approvals: Edits waiting for approval: each changed field with its current and new value. The entry keeps its values until the last approver approves.
descriptions.columns: The statement sheet's groups and columns: add or change columns, formulas, colour rules, widths, freeze panes and who sees each column.

card.docs_overdue_sub: BL + :days days passed, not at the bank

appr.empty: No edit is waiting for approval.
appr.no_approvers: nobody is set for this step
appr.note: Note (optional) — saved with Approve or Reject
appr.approved: Edit approved — the entry now shows the new values.
appr.next: Your approval is saved — the edit now waits for the next approver.
appr.rejected: Edit rejected — the entry keeps its previous values.
appr.withdrawn: Your edit was withdrawn — the entry is unchanged.

imp.hint: Norban's book or this page's export: a new Company Name + Invoice No. is added, an existing one is an edit.
imp.done: Import finished: :created new, :updated updated, :sent sent for approval, :unchanged unchanged.

approval.title: Export Statement edit: :invoice (:company) — :n field(s)
approval.sent: :n edit(s) sent for approval — the entries keep their values until approved.
approval.withdrawn_same: The editor put the entry's own values back.
approval.replaced: Replaced by a newer edit of the same editor.

import.no_edit: this invoice already exists and you may not edit entries.

v.option: :column: pick a value from the list.
v.system_column: A starting column cannot be deleted; hide it instead.
v.invoice_twice: Invoice No. :invoice of :company is entered twice.
v.pending_other: Invoice :invoice is waiting for approval of an edit by :name; it can be edited again once that is approved or rejected.
v.unassigned: Nobody can approve edits yet: set who signs :steps in Approval Center → Approval Workflow (Export Statement Edit).
v.not_your_turn: This edit is not waiting for you.
v.not_yours: Only the editor can withdraw this edit.
